-- Phase 1: declarations and signatures. Bodies are placeholders until Phase 2.

-- True when name is one plain path component: non-empty, no separators,
-- and not "." or "..". Anything else could escape the notes directory.
is_plain_name(name: str) -> bool =
  ex is_plain_name("..") == False
  ex is_plain_name("../secret") == False
  ex is_plain_name("a/b") == False
  ex is_plain_name("note.txt") == True
  if name.char_count() == 0
    return False
  if name == "." or name == ".."
    return False
  if name.split("/").len() != 1
    return False
  if name.split("\\").len() != 1
    return False
  True

-- Reads notes/name. None when the name is not plain, the file is missing,
-- or it cannot be read. Only reads inside the notes directory.
read_note(name: str) -> str? uses fs =
  pre is_plain_name(name)
  ex read_note("no-such-file-for-spec") == None
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    let text = fs.read(name) else return None
    text

-- Text of the first readable note in names, or "" when none can be read.
first_readable(names: List[str]) -> str uses fs =
  ex first_readable([]) == ""
  ex first_readable(["../secret", "missing.txt"]) == ""
  var found = False
  var result = ""
  for name in names
    if not found and is_plain_name(name) and read_note(name) != None
      let text = read_note(name) else ""
      result = text
      found = True
  result

test_is_plain_name() =
  assert is_plain_name("..") == False
  assert is_plain_name("../secret") == False
  assert is_plain_name("a/b") == False
  assert is_plain_name("") == False
  assert is_plain_name("note.txt") == True

test_first_readable() uses fs =
  assert first_readable([]) == ""
  assert first_readable(["../secret", "missing.txt"]) == ""
